about: Item 7 (KPC owner, 2026-11-16): api.pota.app mentions per code file. A Python script names it only in the door. A page may not name it more often than here (its self-spot POST, park details / lookups / user stats it reads on a person's click). Lower a number when a call goes; never raise one. tools/kpc-spot-relay.js is the spot relay itself (the Cloudflare Worker, #226): its one POTA call is the spot list it serves, at most once every 2 minutes.
